test_title: PYST 26: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In this question, two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusion(s) logically follows/follow from the statements.

Statements:

All cows are goats.

Some goats are lions.

Conclusions:

I. All lions are goats.

II. Some cows are lions.

options.text: Neither Conclusion I nor II follow.
Both Conclusions I and II follow

solution:
Given Statements:

All cows are goats.

Some goats are lions.

Possible venn diagram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eaca4d8b787224dda4e236057323acaec697ca801833bc7c91b2fd6129ef6abd.png] 

Conclusion I: All lions are goats. - **False** (Only some goats are lions).

Conclusion II: Some cows are lions. - **False** (No direct relation between cows and lions is established).

Therefore, neither conclusion I nor II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
